_note: Single reviewed bilingual evidence collection for the fictional Northtown reservoir scenario, shared by the retrieval evaluation and the simulation's detector. All documents are scenario records written by the authors; none is a real-world source. relations = reviewed evidence-claim links (fact_id -> S supports / R refutes). release_round and sim_id follow the simulation's release schedule (sim/intervention.py EVIDENCE_SCHEDULE); sim_facts maps the simulation's fact ids (sim/claims.py FACTS) to these facts. F4 (hotel district) and the mayor statement have no settling record. E5 (Harbour district cut) and E6 (a wrong newspaper report that conflicts with E3) are used only by the retrieval evaluation (sim_id null). F3 (city-wide cuts) and F6 (Harbour district cut) are separate facts.

F1.en: The reservoir level fell 12% this month.
F1.tr: Baraj doluluğu bu ay yüzde 12 düştü.

F3.en: City-wide water cuts start next week.
F3.tr: Gelecek hafta şehir genelinde su kesintisi başlıyor.

F4.en: The drop is caused by the new hotel district.

F5.en: Officials are hiding the real numbers.

F6.en: A water cut is scheduled in the Harbour district next week.
F6.tr: Gelecek hafta Liman bölgesinde su kesintisi planlandı.

F7.en: According to the Northtown Water Authority report.

F8.en: Drops like this are normal in the dry season.
F8.tr: Bu tür düşüşler kurak mevsimde olağan.

evidence.title: Monthly reservoir report, October
evidence.text: Monthly report of the Northtown Water Authority: the reservoir level fell 12% this month.

evidence.title: Aylık baraj raporu, Ekim
evidence.text: Northtown Su İdaresi aylık raporu: baraj doluluğu bu ay yüzde 12 düştü.

evidence.title: Press statement on water supply
evidence.text: No city-wide water cuts are planned for next week.

evidence.title: Su arzı hakkında basın açıklaması
evidence.text: Gelecek hafta şehir genelinde su kesintisi planlanmıyor.

evidence.title: Maintenance notice
evidence.text: A scheduled water cut will take place in the Harbour district next Tuesday for pipe maintenance.

evidence.title: News report on water supply
evidence.text: City officials told the newspaper that city-wide water cuts will start next week because rainfall stayed low.

evidence.title: Reservoir capacity data
evidence.text: Capacity data: the reservoir is at 58% of capacity, far from empty. Drops like this are normal in the dry season.

evidence.title: Baraj kapasite verisi
evidence.text: Kapasite verisi: baraj kapasitesinin yüzde 58'inde, boş olmaktan çok uzak. Bu tür düşüşler kurak mevsimde olağan.

evidence.title: Open reservoir data
evidence.text: The raw daily reservoir data are published openly on the authority website, so the real numbers are public.

evidence.title: Açık baraj verisi
evidence.text: Ham günlük baraj verileri idarenin internet sitesinde açıkça yayımlanıyor; gerçek rakamlar herkese açık.
